items.finding: Raman spectroscopy is frequently applied in upstream processing due to its high selectivity and low water interference despite long measurement times.
items.how_it_applies: This suggests testing Raman spectroscopy for real-time monitoring of glucose to evaluate if low water interference benefits sugar tracking in aqueous media.
items.limits_and_transfer_risks: The literature finding comes from general upstream processing reviews rather than the specific cell culture matrix or instrument scale proposed here.
